scope_note: Single-feature zero-catalogue PILOT of the flight-line notch + tilt-edge transform. It does NOT implement the full drape-height source-depth model in the parent hypothesis. It tests only whether the notch changes holdout DTI for a fixed-budget placement of one physics-derived score surface.

official_sources.metric: https://www.drivendata.org/competitions/306/competition-doe-gems/page/967/ (DTI, alpha=0.2, beta=0.8, triangular kernel R=300 m)
official_sources.geodawn_flight_geometry: https://www.usgs.gov/data/geodawn-airborne-magnetic-and-radiometric-surveys-northwestern-great-basin-nevada-and (Area 1 lines 200 m spacing; Area 2 lines 400 m spacing; both azimuth 90 deg; magnetic micro-leveling applied by contractor)

input_layers.rtp: training_features.tif band 2 (rtp, Reduced to pole magnetic data), EPSG:32611, 100 m, restored from registry/data_manifest.json id training_features

transform.step_1: Fill non-finite and out-of-footprint RTP with the footprint median; no catalogue information used.
transform.step_2_notch_arm: Multiply FFT of RTP by a notch that zeroes |f_x| <= 0.02 cycles/px and |f_y| within 0.02 of 0.25 or 0.5 cycles/px (E-W flight-line artifact bands for 400 m and 200 m line spacing at 100 m pixels).
transform.step_3: Tilt angle theta = atan2(Vz, Hgrad) from the (optionally notched) field computed by FFT derivatives.
transform.step_4: Score S = |grad theta| * exp(-(theta/0.15)^2), normalised by its 99th percentile over the scored footprint and clipped to [0,1].

placement: Greedy descending-S placement with minimum Euclidean separation 3 px, restricted to footprint & (distance to visible catalogue > 2 px), budget fixed at 37,654 dots (equal to the H33 / C0 comparator budget), binary value 1.0.

arms.B_control_no_notch: Identical transform without notch (isolates the notch)
arms.C0_random: Uniform random in-footprint placement with the same 3 px separation and 37,654-dot budget (sanity comparator; project receipts C0 = 0.0497 / 0.0422)

primary_metric: HOLDOUT-DTI via vendor/gems57 evaluate (gems57-pooled-hide-v2), 4 quadrant folds pooled, paired physical 20 km block bootstrap, 1000 draws

decision_rules.R1_canary: Single-feature AUC of S for holdout truth vs background must be <= 0.90, else leakage is presumed and the pilot is stopped.
decision_rules.R2_notch_effect: Arm A must exceed Arm B with paired 95% CI lower bound > 0 on BOTH seeds to attribute gain to the notch.
decision_rules.R3_spend_bar: A slot may only be considered if the best arm exceeds the current holdout best of 0.1905 (seed 20) and 0.1944 (seed 30) for G79-THVC. Expected to fail for a single feature; a failure is a negative result, not a reason to retune.
decision_rules.R4_fold_check: Withheld-positive counts per seed must be reported. Project receipts record 11,321 (seed 20) and 11,342 (seed 30); a mismatch is an irregularity to report, not to fix by editing the shared module.

budget: 1 experiment (this lane), 2 seeds, 3 arms, approximately 45 minutes; no retuning of notch band, kernel or threshold after seeing results.
named_non_fault_mimics: Residual E-W micro-leveling and tie-line artifacts that survive contractor processing (USGS page states micro-leveling was applied)
Edges of magnetic bodies (plutons, paleochannel basalts) with no fault-slip history
known_limitations: A notch on |f_x| <= 0.02 also attenuates true E-W-striking faults at the notched frequencies; the pilot accepts this and reports it.
No drape-height or flight-height model is used; the USGS flight height is a range, not a per-pixel grid.
A single feature with no learned model is not expected to beat the 0.1905 bar.
